notes.title: Game Update February 27
notes.notes:
- Swordman damage reduced from 2 to 1
- A swordman doesn't dodge when very close to player
- Vibroblade cooldown after kill series reduced from 1.1 to 0.88
- Improved hitboxes
- Improved game experience with gamepad
- Better camera on the maze-type levels
- Invulnerability dash timer slightly increased
- The main character doesn't leap so fast forward as before during attacks
